QUOTE: "Deny is enforced later, in `ServerManager::execute`." / "`ServerManager::execute` └─ is_denied(deny list)? → "Error: Permission denied for <tool>" └─ route_tool_call"
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says deny is checked in `ServerManager::execute` before routing. It never concludes that the deny list is the only list that blocks execution. It also says the allow list and callback are approval-side, and that an approval failure denies the call ("Permission denied") in `ToolExecutor`, so it describes two blocking points.
